messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Metering emit anomaly detected. Token_count delta > 30% vs baseline across multiple partitions (US-WEST, EU). Runbook: metering/emit-drift. Paging oncall.

jamal: oncall here, ack. starting triage. tagging billing-engineering and eng-infra.

morgan: on it — initial symptom: token counts inflated ~25-40% for a subset of customers. We also see delayed usage batches for same time window. Tailing emitter logs now.

morgan: logs snippet: ```json
{"emitter_id":"emitter-21","event":"emit","tokens":1200,"ts":"2026-03-17T13:59:50Z"}
```

lina: eng-infra here — kafka consumer lag spike on topic "metering.emit" starting ~13:58Z. Lag peaked ~52k, a partition rebalance happened at ~14:00Z. No brokers OOM, but one consumer pod restarted.

jamal: is the restart correlated with any 502/5xx from the proxy? @sara can you check gateway logs?

sara: billing-engineering checking gateway — yes, proxy reported increased 502s between 13:57:30Z and 14:00:10Z. Example: ```text
[2026-03-17T13:58:12Z] proxy-12 502 GET /emit -> upstream timeout
```

morgan: suspected flow: proxy 502s caused emitter retries; some retries lacked idempotency token, leading to duplicate emits. Confirming duplicate keys in aggregator backlog.

jamal: mitigation plan 1) block customer-facing overage flags, 2) enable shadow-mode for billing flags, 3) run safe reconcile/backfill with dedupe. Can someone flip shadow-mode? :pray:

sara: flipping shadow-mode now (PATCH /admin/shadow_mode -> true). Shadow-mode enabled. No new outbound overage flags will be sent. :white_check_mark:

morgan: verified: outbound gateway now returns 200 but flags are not posted to customers. Downstream aggregator still receives events into shadow ledger (good for recon). Running quick recon check: `python tools/reconcile.py --window 15m --check-token-delta`

jamal: customer-impact callout: ~120 customers queued for overage notification in the 13:58-14:05 window. Because shadow-mode is on, they will not receive flags; CS notified.

ashley: CS here — holding all outbound communication, creating internal ticket with affected accounts list. Will wait for engineering confirmation before any credit or email.

morgan: root cause hypothesis: emitter produced duplicate writes during a retry storm when proxy returned 502s; idempotency header enforcement wasn't strict on retry path. Found an emitter instance restart at 13:59 which reprocessed in-flight backlog. Proxy spike -> emitter restart -> duplicates.

sara: reproducer snippet from proxy: ```text
[2026-03-17T13:58:05Z] upstream timeout -> 502; emitter retried without X-Idempotency header for 18s window.
```

morgan: initiating hotfix: enable idempotency enforcement in emitter (v1.1.3 hotfix) and enable aggregator-side de-dupe for recent window. Rolling to 2 pods to shave restart flakiness. Command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/emitter emitter=registry/redwood/emitter:v1.1.3-hotfix`

jamal: running runbook step: metering_reconcile -> safe backfill. Starting job.

morgan: backfill job started: job-id=618765-backfill-1, monitoring logs. ETA ~6m. I'll post progress.

Incident Bot: Update: shadow-mode enabled, outbound flags blocked. Severity lowered to P2 while active impact prevented.

morgan: backfill completed; dedupe removed ~14k duplicate token events; net billing delta for window normalized to <1.2% vs baseline. No automatic charges were applied due to shadow-mode.

sara: rolling emitter hotfix to stable — all pods at v1.1.3-hotfix and idempotency header enforced. Proxy retries remain low.

jamal: next steps: 1) keep shadow-mode for 1h to ensure no late waves, 2) run full reconcile for last 48h to confirm no residual dupes, 3) postmortem + customer credit plan if any residual overcharges detected.

morgan: added incident tasks to board: postmortem, reconciliations, and manual audit for flagged customers.

ashley: CS will prepare customer comms template in case credits are required.

jamal: handing off monitoring to morning oncall. If anything new surfaces please page the rotation. I'll run the postmortem doc tomorrow AM.

morgan: marking thread resolved for live mitigation. Will attach logs and reconcile report to incident ticket.

Incident Bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Handed off to oncall for follow-up. Logs and job artifacts attached to incident ticket.
